description: This file defines the interface 'InterestPauseWritePlatformService' which declares methods for creating, deleting, and updating interest pause periods associated with loans, identified either by internal or external IDs. It serves as a contract for implementing interest pause management functionality within a loan portfolio management system.

classes.name: InterestPauseWritePlatformService
classes.description: Interface declaring methods for managing interest pause periods on loans, including creation, deletion, and updates via internal or external loan identifiers.

methods.name: createInterestPause
methods.description: Creates a new interest pause period for a loan, identified either by external ID or internal ID, specifying start and end dates with formatting and locale options.

methods.name: deleteInterestPause
methods.description: Deletes an existing interest pause period for a loan, identified either by internal ID or external ID.

methods.name: updateInterestPause
methods.description: Updates an existing interest pause period's start and end dates for a specified loan, identified by internal ID or external ID, with date formatting and locale parameters.
